sloka: निमग्नतालुः स्फुटिताक्षितारो निष्क्रान्तजिह्वो ऽचलसन्निकाशः।स तस्य वाजी निपपात भूमौ तलप्रहारेण विशीर्णमूर्धा ।। ६.६९.९४ ।।
transliteration: nimagnatāluḥ sphuṭitākṣitāro niṣkrāntajihvo 'calasannikāśaḥ।sa tasya vājī nipapāta bhūmau talaprahāreṇa viśīrṇamūrdhā ।। 6.69.94 ।।

translations.english: Naranthaka's chest having been split by a blow on his chest, vomiting flaming blood from his throat was as if shattered by the stroke of lightning fell down like a mountain.
